verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API and explicitly supports automating flag toggles from a deploy script via the toggle feature endpoint. A hands-on probe confirms the headless path: a dockerized self-host was booted, and a user, organization, feature and SDK connection were all created through the API with no UI. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or official CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action) documented for pipelines, and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
automate it (for example, from a deploy script) with the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
Get results for an experiment (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`) to pull the latest analysis into your own reporting.
the first user and organization were created through the API, a boolean feature `pa-probe-flag` was created, an SDK connection was minted
